local todo_count=$(grep -c "TODO\|FIXME" "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
echo "   📋 Found $todo_count TODOs in: $(basename "$file")"
echo "$(date): $todo_count TODOs in $file" >> "$ENHANCEMENT_LOG"
if ! echo "$line" | grep -qE "(example|sample|placeholder|TODO|FIXME|test|demo)"; then
# Convert TODO comments to structured documentation
echo "🔧 Converting TODO comments to structured documentation..."
s/\/\/ FIXME:/\/\/\/ - FIXME:/g
# Check for TODO/FIXME in staged files
todos=$(git diff --cached | grep -n "TODO\|FIXME\|XXX" || true)
echo "Note: TODO/FIXME comments found in staged changes:"
# Check for TODO/FIXME comments
todos=$(count_lines "TODO\|FIXME\|HACK")
- **Issue:** Found $todos TODO/FIXME/HACK comments
# Convert TODO comments to structured documentation
echo "🔧 Converting TODO comments to structured documentation..."
s/\/\/ FIXME:/\/\/\/ - FIXME:/g
patterns=$(find "$project_path" -name "*.swift" -exec grep -l "TODO\|FIXME\|class\|struct\|func" {} \; | wc -l)
# Process exported todo-tree-output.json and take action on TODOs
# Actions: generate issues, assign agents, or trigger workflows based on TODOs
TODO_JSON="${WORKSPACE_DIR}/todo-tree-output.json"

echo "❌ TODO JSON file not found: ${TODO_JSON}" | tee -a "${LOG_FILE}"
echo "🔍 Processing TODOs from${$TODO_JSO}N..." | tee -a ${$LOG_FIL}E"
# Example: For each TODO, print details and (optionally) trigger further automation
jq -c '.[]' "${TODO_JSON}" | while read -r todo; do

echo "✅ TODO processing complete." | tee -a "${LOG_FILE}"
